extensionDescription.message: Catch up to buffered Twitch live video with an explicit ON/OFF control.

defaultEnabledHelp.message: Automatically follow live when opening a page or switching channels. Catching up skips part of the video.

manualControlHelp.message: Use the player’s ON/OFF control while watching. Turn it OFF before rewinding.

autoSaveHelp.message: Changes are saved automatically and apply to the next page you open.

loadError.message: Could not load settings. Please reload this page.

saved.message: Saved. Changes apply to the next page you open.

saveError.message: Could not save settings. Please try again.

waitingLive.message: Waiting for live video to follow

followHelp.message: When ON, parts of the video may be skipped to follow live. Turn OFF before rewinding.
